associations.rationale: This gives an existence realization of a simple centralizer module as Hom_A(V,E), only one direction of the stated bijection.
This is a congruence helper transporting A-module equivalences to centralizer-module hom spaces.
This is the converse isomorphism helper needed for injectivity, not the full correspondence statement.
This gives an equivalence of opaque isotypic-component sets without directly stating the Hom_A mapping on simple modules.
